inventory_rationale: State 6 freezes the accepted module operations plus the callable symbols required by deterministic http_router_backend/v1 and the accepted Stage 8.1 concrete local access-control repair: the runtime port, PostgreSQL implementation, offline administration and composition operations, app factory, credential extractor, principal resolver, and one canonical handler for each externally exposed State 5 operation. No additional implementation-private helpers are invented for coverage; reopen this plan only when later accepted evidence requires another stable callable seam.
